crossRefs.note: to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,
For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,
to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.
that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.
For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well.
She said, “The Philistines are upon you, Samson!” He awoke out of his sleep, and said, “I will go out as at other…
The Philistines laid hold on him and put out his eyes; and they brought him down to Gaza and bound him with fetters of…
Didn’t Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? Yet among many nations there was no king like him, and he was loved…
I find more bitter than death the woman whose heart is snares and traps, whose hands are chains. Whoever pleases God…
Yahweh saw and abhorred, because of the provocation of his sons and his daughters.
So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.

translations.web: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit. He who is under Yahweh’s wrath will fall into it.
translations.bsb: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit; he who is under the wrath of the LORD will fall into it.
translations.kjv: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit: he that is abhorred of the LORD shall fall
translations.asv: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit: He that is abhorred of Jehovah shall fall therein.
